goal: R49 «plan a segmentation section and the campaign section where user can segment who's going to target or retarget … I wanted to be real market built, not just requirement assumption. Do benchmark with at least nine tools that has this retargeting segmentation and then build.» + R50 «do the UI and then update the agent prompt with [System Prompt v2]».

scores.rationale: intent_fidelity 9. He asked for market-built, not assumption-built, and named a number — nine. He got eleven platforms with per-claim URLs, and the research demonstrably CHANGED the design three times rather than decorating it: the window moved onto the positive signal, a cooldown check was added because WATI and AiSensy structurally cannot express one, a tenure guard came from Customer.io's documented trap. R50's second half landed too — I read the installed prompt at massar-engine/src/agent.ts:194 and it carries his own four sections (الهدف · السياق · التوقعات · المصادر) in his own order, with the eight prior-round guards inside it rather than bolted beside it. Not 10 because his sentence was «segment who's going to target or retarget» — the verb is transitive, and here it does not yet take an object. completeness 6, and I am not rounding this up because the labelling is good. Define and preview work; save, schedule, and launch do not. That is a third of R49, and honest framing makes it shippable, not complete. What keeps it from lower: the missing third is externally blocked on approved Meta templates, not on effort, and R50 landed whole. coherence 9. Every part of this argues the same thing. The builder sits in wizard step 2 AWAY from the message on purpose — a behavioural audience is outside the 24h window by construction — which is precisely the trap the benchmark caught WATI and AiSensy in. The disabled bar at dashboard.ts:1105 says «الإطلاق ينتظر القوالب المعتمدة», not «اخترت لا أحد», so the reason it gives is the true one. The presets carry the market's own names. Not 10 because five zeros in a row still argue, visually, that something is broken. taste 8. The preset shelf FILLS the condition rows instead of hiding them — that is the difference between a template and a teacher. Window chips are right, the reasons are specific («رُوسلت قبل N ساعة»). Held at 8 by the zero state. surprise 7. Two things I did not order: suppressed contacts are RETURNED with their reason rather than dropped — no tool in the benchmark of eleven does that, and it is the actual differentiator — and the builder caught that the launch list was being built from a 12-row DISPLAY sample, which would have sent to twelve and reported 12/12 delivered on a segment of forty.

verdict_rationale: The market research was real, it is traceable, and it changed the design in three places an assumption-built version would have gotten wrong. The build is a correct, honest third of the ask, and every edge of that third is enforced in code, not promised in a report. The launch block is the right call, not a cop-out. The zeros are honest but they are the one place this ships weaker than it should.
cpo_spot_checks: Prompt v2 fidelity (STATE.md claim, independently verified): massar-engine/src/agent.ts:194 onward carries the founder's own section headers ١) الهدف · ٢) السياق · ٣) التوقعات · ٤) المصادر in his order, including the منصة صحة handling path and the ≤45-word / one-question rules. Claim holds.

Launch block (mechanism, independently verified): massar-engine/src/dashboard.ts:1105-1109 renders «الشريحة محسوبة — الإطلاق ينتظر القوالب المعتمدة» and emits a real `disabled aria-disabled="true"` on the button, not a CSS-inert lookalike. Claim holds.

rulings.scope_honesty: SHIP. A clearly-labelled third is the right ship because the missing two thirds are the parts that would have been guessed. Define + preview is the half of segmentation that the benchmark actually informed; save/schedule/launch is the half that depends on approved templates the founder does not yet have. A first-time user in «حسب السلوك» can believe exactly one thing — that they can describe an audience and see who it catches — and that is true. The disabled launch bar is what makes the label honest rather than marketing.
rulings.launch_block: RIGHT CALL. An enabled button whose send WhatsApp refuses AFTER the founder confirms is a worse product than a disabled button that says why. The rationale is structural, not a shortcut: a behavioural audience is outside the 24h window by construction, and /admin/campaign/launch is session-only. A template send path is the correct fix — but it is a new capability with a Meta approval dependency, not a missing line of code, and shipping it half-built would have put a real outbound send behind a button. Deferred to a change order, not charged against this round.
rulings.the_zeros: HONEST, BUT THE WEAKEST SURFACE. Five presets reading ٠ with per-preset reasons is correct engineering and the reasons are the right instinct. It is still the first thing the founder sees, and «صفر» five times reads as broken before it reads as honest. Not blocking — the reasons are present and the data is genuinely one day old — but the empty state must carry the forecast, not just the cause. Change order CO-1.

change_orders.title: The zero state must forecast, not just explain
change_orders.detail: Every preset reading ٠ states its cause; none states when it stops being ٠. Use the tenure forecast already in src/segments.ts to turn each zero into «٠ اليوم — ٣ جهات تدخل هذه الشريحة خلال ٤ أيام» or «٠ — الكتاب عمره يوم واحد، هذه الشريحة تحتاج ٧ أيام من السجل». A zero with a date is a working product; a zero with an excuse is a broken one.

change_orders.title: Close the other two thirds: save, then launch via template
change_orders.detail: Saved audiences (name + persist + re-evaluate on open) is the next increment and has no external dependency. The template send path is the one after it and IS gated on approved Meta templates — surface that dependency to the founder as a decision, not as engineering work.

change_orders.title: Suppressed-contact visibility
change_orders.detail: Suppressed contacts are RETURNED not dropped — correct, and the differentiator versus WATI/AiSensy. The UI must make that legible: show the suppressed count beside the eligible count so the founder learns that «٠» often means «٣ مكتومون» rather than «لا أحد».

qa_note: QA reported FAIL 4/6. Both failures were independently re-verified closed by the CPO at this commit, not taken on report: (1) an unknown behavioural signal now returns HTTP 400 with «حدث غير معروف: «zzz»» where it previously returned 500; (2) `npm run smoke` exits 0 across consecutive runs after the filter was corrected to read `m.location.url`. Delivery gate PASS at c06f71c: 71 scenarios, 18 comparisons, 6 surfaces. Build exits 0. Health ok. No WhatsApp message was sent at any point in this review.

evidence_accepted.benchmark: .orbit/artifacts/segmentation/BENCHMARK.md — 11 platforms, per-claim URLs. Three traceable design changes: time window moved onto the positive signal (Klaviyo «Before»), cooldown/suppression check added at evaluation because WATI+AiSensy structurally cannot express it, tenure guard added from Customer.io's documented trap.
evidence_accepted.implementation: src/segments.ts — five primitives, five presets in the market's own names, suppressed contacts returned not dropped, tenure forecast.
evidence_accepted.safety: PASS — 8/8 prompt guards located by line; 21/21 adversarial opt-out ordering; every path traced, no behavioural segment reaches safeSend.

user_model_updates: The founder asked for market-built, not assumption-built, and named a number (nine tools). He gets what he asks for and he checks: the benchmark is the reason this round passes. Cite sources by URL in future research rounds by default.

He prefers a labelled third over a guessed whole. Partial scope is acceptable to him when the boundary is visible IN the product; it is not acceptable when the boundary lives only in a summary message.
A disabled control with a stated reason reads to him as competence. Prefer refusing in the UI over failing after confirmation — this is now the second round where that choice was the right one.
Honest zeros are necessary but not sufficient for him: he judges on first impression. Empty states should carry a forecast or a next action, never only a cause.
user_impact_summary_ar:
الآن يمكنك تعريف شريحة من عملائك حسب سلوكهم الفعلي — من فتح، من ردّ، من أبدى اهتماماً ثم صمت — ومعاينة من تلتقطه الشريحة قبل أي إجراء. الخمسة قوالب الجاهزة مبنية على دراسة إحدى عشرة منصة عالمية بأسمائها ومصادرها، لا على افتراض: نافذة الوقت، وفحص فترة التهدئة، وحارس عمر السجل — كلها جاءت من ثغرات حقيقية في تلك المنصات.

ما يعمل اليوم: التعريف والمعاينة. ما لا يعمل بعد: الحفظ والجدولة والإطلاق — وهذا مكتوب أمامك في الشاشة لا في تقرير.

زر الإطلاق في وضع «حسب السلوك» معطّل عمداً، ومكتوب سببه: «الشريحة محسوبة — الإطلاق ينتظر القوالب المعتمدة». الجمهور السلوكي يقع خارج نافذة الأربع وعشرين ساعة بطبيعته، وواتساب سيرفض الإرسال. الأفضل أن نمنع الزر الآن من أن نرفض بعد أن تضغط.

الأرقام تقرأ ٠ في القوالب الخمسة، وكل قالب يذكر سببه: الكتاب عمره يوم واحد، وثلاث جهات مؤهلة لكنها في فترة تهدئة. الرقم صادق، لكن الخطوة القادمة أن يقول لك متى يتوقف عن كونه صفراً.

لم تُرسل أي رسالة واتساب في هذه الجولة.
next_round_goal: CO-1 (الصفر الذي يتنبأ) ثم الشرائح المحفوظة — CO-2 الجزء الأول.
